digest.component_or_area: plan-review coaching moves and project criteria routing
propositions: When a plan's affected-file or call-site inventory is enumerated by hand or demonstrably incomplete rather than derived from the symbol graph, a project-only advisory criterion must fire and direct re-derivation with find_referencing_symbols and string-literal sweep.

Code-review moves are already overlay-driven via load_move_registry reading .rebar/code_review_moves.json, but project.* criteria cannot fire code-review applies_when tags because they are drawn from a closed vocabulary (OVERLAY_IDS ∪ "always"), making code-review routing impossible and plan-review the correct destination.

The overlay must define project.symbol-reference-completeness with default_posture advisory (no blocking_enabled key), activate entry ["plan_review"] only, a prompt detecting hand-enumerated inventory, and a move template directing find_referencing_symbols plus string-literal site detection.
No src/rebar/ shipped defaults are modified; the criterion exists only in .rebar/ overlays, proven by test assertion that the criterion id appears nowhere under src/rebar/.

Live detection across seven real review-plan runs against hand-enumerated plans fires the criterion at validity 1.0 and names omitted files including string-literal sites the LSP cannot resolve; contrast reviews of complete inventories correctly abstain.
